People around Jack often share different ideas about the chess corner. Mia and Jack are preparing a report about the chess corner. Jack thanked Mia for the honest advice. In fact, we visit Nana every Sunday for her homemade apple pie.
Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There are always more possibilities than we expect. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The clearance sale emptied the shelves.

The guitar case has become an important part of daily life. Jack will take part in a table tennis match in April. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Also, my Cambodian friend taught me her family's noodle recipe.

On Tuesday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. The experience taught Jack more than any book could. Jack prefers cloudy weather when running in the gym. What's more, the screen is too bright at night.
Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook. At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. Little by little, things began to change.
